text:
Maya: FYI I found a weird pattern in the synthetic prompt splits after the last quant bring-up. Looks like some anchors are rotating between shards and leaking holdout samples into train.
Sam: ugh. timeline? is this pre- or post-quantization run?
Maya: Post-quant. Ran eval-harness v2.7 + quantized model. The failing cohorts are ones generated with the new anchor sampler.
Jon: can you paste the anchor code snip? maybe modulus changed or seed drift.
Maya: here — small excerpt:
```
# anchor assignment
anchor_key = f"{sample['id']}-{sample['source']}"
anchor = int(hashlib.sha256(anchor_key.encode()).hexdigest(), 16) % 1024
shard = anchor % num_shards
```
Sam: ah, %1024 then %num_shards. if num_shards changed or we switched hashing lib that could reorder anchors.
Alex: we did bump num_shards from 16->32 in the runner config for parallelism last week.
Ritesh: that would explain toggling because old fixtures were anchored to 16. New assignment moves a subset into different folds.
Maya: right. The synthetic generator saved anchor metadata in fixtures, but the eval runner recomputes anchors on ingestion — mismatch.
Sam: so leakage happens when fixtures were created under one sharding regime and evaluated under another.
Jon: quick mitigation: make the runner prefer stored anchor if present, else compute. But that requires schema change in fixtures.
Maya: proposed fix in my head: add anchor: <int> to fixture header and change dataset loader to read it. I'll open a tiny PR.
Ritesh: also add a CI gating test that replays a small fixture across shard configs and asserts no holdout overlap.
Alex: name the job eval-harness-anchor-guard. Should be cheap (100 samples) and run on PRs touching runner or generator.
Sam: can we also add a checksum assert for fixture -> loader roundtrip? something like:
```
assert stored_anchor == loader_computed_anchor or stored_anchor is not None
```
Jon: better: fail if stored_anchor exists and doesn't match computed. That surfaces inconsistencies instead of silently accepting.
Maya: ok i'll do: loader will error if stored_anchor present and different. PR will include migration script to backfill existing fixtures by recomputing anchors with current num_shards param.
Ritesh: be careful with backfill — we need to pin the exact hashing code used when fixtures were generated. Some early fixtures used mmh3, newer ones use hashlib.sha256.
Maya: noted. I'll add a small mapping table for generator version -> hashing impl. Backfill will pick hashing impl based on fixture metadata.
CI-bot: NOTE: existing fixtures without generator_version will be flagged in the new lint step.
Alex: timeline? we should prioritize because this is affecting evaluation regressions and gating model bring-ups.
Maya: I'll draft PR today, run the Anchor-guard job locally, and ping y'all. If all good, ship to main then add the CI job.
Sam: thanks — once PR up, tag me for review. I'll write the test harness.
Jon: also add a short dashboard tile (console) to show "anchor drift" metric across runs so QE can spot it early.
Maya: will add TODO in PR and create a follow-up ticket for the dashboard.
Ritesh: 👍 nice catch.
Alex: :rocket:
